title: Protein extraction from Aiptasia
author: OSU Weis Lab
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.rifd4bn

steps.title: Prepare anemones
steps.instruction: Place anemones in the incubator in artificial seawater (ASW) for 3-4 days prior to extraction.

substeps.instruction: Change the ASW each day to remove residual debris.

steps.title: Homogenize anemone tissue
steps.instruction: Transfer 4-5 large anemones to a small tissue grinder on ice with 0.5-1 mL of chilled extraction buffer.

substeps.instruction: Blot anemones on Kimwipes or weigh paper upon removal from their original container to remove as much water as possible.

steps.title: Centrifuge homogenate
steps.instruction: Transfer the homogenate to a 1.5 mL tube and centrifuge at 14,000xg for 15 minutes at 4°C to pellet dinoflagellates and cell debris.

steps.title: Collect supernatant
steps.instruction: Remove the supernatant and place it in a new tube, taking care not to disturb the white lipid layer.

steps.title: Quantify protein concentration
steps.instruction: Determine the concentration of the protein using a Bradford assay.

steps.title: Aliquot and store protein
steps.instruction: Aliquot the protein into 100 µl volumes and store in a -80°C freezer.

substeps.instruction: Store in the fridge on ice for short periods.
